trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The bullywug can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Speak with Frogs and Toads
entries: The bullywug can communicate simple concepts to frogs and toads when it speaks in Bullywug.

action.name: Insectile Rapier
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) Piercing damage plus 2 ({@damage 1d4}) Poison damage.

bonus.name: Leap
entries: The bullywug can jump up to 30 feet by spending 10 feet of movement.
